fixes.explanation: I wish that were true, friend, but the verse says otherwise. "Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her." Not one of them shows up. So the answer is False, and I think that's the loneliest part of the whole verse. (Lamentations 1:2)

False, and the text is blunt about it. "Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her." She weeps aloud in the night, with tears upon her cheeks. The verse adds that all her friends have betrayed her and become her enemies, so nobody is coming. (Lamentations 1:2)
